principle: Standards define semantics; providers own external reality; mature external implementations are candidates for mechanics, not automatic winners. External existence or age is not substitution evidence. For a replaceable mechanism, Ordivon admits the external implementation only after a contract-equivalent comparative qualification against the smallest credible local baseline; Ordivon retains only the better mechanism plus cross-owner composition/authority/evidence/reconciliation seams.
